meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你在 NanoClaw 里加一个本地监控面板，显示代理组、会话、频道、用户、令牌用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志；它同时会安装一个数据推送器，每 60 秒把数据库数据、每 2 秒把日志推送给面板，并自动改好启动代码。
howto.when: 当你说「给 NanoClaw 加个监控面板」「装上 dashboard」之类的话，或要求显示代理组、会话、令牌用量等监控信息时，Claude 会执行这个流程。

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw that shows agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and real-time logs. It adds a pusher that sends DB snapshots every 60s and log tail every 2s to the dashboard, and wires startup in the code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, or mentions viewing agent groups, sessions, token usage, or similar monitoring info.
